reason: A better satisfies the full proposal requirements by providing cited support, a defined baseline, a plausible low-density precipitation-strengthening intervention, and a microstructure-linked falsification experiment. Its main weakness is extrapolating FCC CoNiV evidence to BCC refractory alloys without establishing that minor Al will form stable nanoscale B2 precipitates at 800–1150 °C, but B offers no supporting evidence and specifies an ambiguous, unsupported Y2O3 addition range.
